ESWAR SAYEMPU 
Austin, TX | +1 (601) 658-6998 | esayempu@gmail.com | LinkedIn | Portfolio 
  
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Data  Engineer  with  3+  years  of  experience  building  scalable  data  pipelines,  cloud  data  platforms,  and  analytics 
solutions  across  financial  services  and  fintech  environments.  Experienced  in  developing  batch  and  streaming 
workflows using Python, PySpark, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, AWS Glue, Redshift, Snowflake, and PostgreSQL, supporting 
financial datasets with reliable data processing and delivery. Strong background in ETL/ELT, data ingestion, dimensional 
modeling,  data  marts,  SQL  optimization,  reconciliation,  automated  data  quality,  and  DataOps  practices.  Builds 
financial analytics solutions by integrating market data, transaction datasets, and reporting workflows while partnering 
with BI, analytics, and business teams to deliver governed datasets, insights, and AI/ML-ready data products. 
 
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
Programming & SQL: Python, PySpark, SQL, pandas, Bash, CTEs, Window Functions, Query Optimization 
Data Engineering & Integration: ETL/ELT, Data Ingestion, Data Transformation, Batch & Streaming Pipelines, AWS Glue, 
Apache Airflow, dbt, Apache Spark, Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka, REST API Integration 
Cloud  &  Data  Platforms: AWS,  Amazon  S3,  Amazon  Redshift,  Snowflake,  Amazon  RDS, CloudWatch,  Big  Data,  Data 
Platform Engineering 
Database  &  Warehouse  Engineering: PostgreSQL,  Relational  Databases,  Database  Engineering,  Data  Warehousing, 
Data  Modeling,  Dimensional  Modeling,  Star  Schema,  Fact  &  Dimension  Tables,  SCD  Type  II,  Data  Marts, Schema 
Design, Indexing 
DataOps & Pipeline Reliability: DataOps, Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Workflow Orchestration, Pipeline Monitoring, Data 
Observability, Retry & Backfill Management, Data Quality Gates, Automated Data Testing 
Analytics  Engineering  &  BI: Analytics  Engineering,  Business  Intelligence,  Power  BI,  Tableau,  Reporting  Marts,  KPI 
Datasets, Metric Definitions, Dashboard Data Pipelines, Analytical Data Models 
Data Quality & Governance: Data Quality, Source-to-Target Validation, Data Reconciliation, Data Profiling, Schema 
Validation, Data Freshness Checks, Business Rule Validation, Data Documentation 
Generative  AI  &  Applied  AI: OpenAI  GPT-4,  LangChain,  FAISS,  Retrieval-Augmented  Generation  (RAG),  Vector 
Embeddings, Perplexity Sonar APIs, Google Vision OCR, Streamlit 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Data Engineer                                                                                                                                             Jun 2025 - Present 
LPL Financial | USA 
â€¢ Engineered  18+  AWS  Glue  and  PySpark  ETL  pipelines  to  ingest  advisor  APIs,  transactional  feeds,  database 
views, and Amazon S3 extracts into Redshift, processing 2+ TB monthly for analytics and reporting. 
â€¢ Orchestrated 15+ Apache Airflow workflows with dependencies, retries, backfills, and CloudWatch monitoring, 
maintaining 99.5% scheduled completion for advisor and client data pipelines. 
â€¢ Optimized SQL CTEs, window functions, joins, and aggregations across 25+ Redshift transformations, reducing 
recurring advisor KPI processing time by 60% for downstream Business Intelligence workloads. 
â€¢ Modeled  14+  advisor  and  client  entities  in  Amazon  RDS  for  PostgreSQL  using  normalized  schemas,  keys, 
relationships, and indexing, reducing data inconsistencies across 6 downstream workflows. 
â€¢ Developed an 8-table Redshift star schema with fact tables, dimensions, and SCD Type II history, supporting 
20+ advisor-engagement KPIs consumed through Power BI reporting datasets. 
â€¢ Automated  CI/CD  validation  across  5  engineering  repositories  using  GitHub  Actions,  Python,  SQL,  and  data 
quality gates, reducing deployment-related pipeline defects by 30% before production releases. 
â€¢ Validated 42 source-to-target business rules through Python, pandas, SQL reconciliation, schema validation, 
and freshness checks, detecting 95%+ of data discrepancies before reporting-mart refreshes. 
â€¢ Published  governed  feature  datasets  for  2  client-loyalty  and  insight-generation  model  workflows,  partnering 
with data scientists and analytics teams to document feature logic, refresh rules, and validation criteria. 
 
Data Engineer                                                                                           May 2021 - Jun 2023 
Fiserv | India 
â€¢ Consolidated  14+  payment,  transaction,  settlement,  and  merchant  data  sources  using  AWS  Glue,  PySpark, 
Amazon S3, and SQL pipelines, processing 700+ GB monthly into analytical datasets for reporting and insights.  
â€¢ Refactored 35+ dbt SQL models across Snowflake staging, intermediate, and mart layers, improving financial 
data consistency and reducing recurring transformation cycle time by 32%.  
â€¢ Integrated  external  APIs,  batch  files,  and  relational  database  extracts  through  Python  and  SQL  workflows, 
reducing manual data preparation effort across 10+ recurring finance reporting processes by 40%.  

 
 
â€¢ Designed  Snowflake  dimensional  models  with  fact  tables,  dimension  tables,  and  SCD  Type  II  patterns, 
supporting 22+ payment and settlement KPIs consumed by BI teams for operational reporting.  
â€¢ Configured  18+  Apache  Airflow  workflows  with  scheduling,  dependencies,  retries,  and  backfill  handling, 
improving daily pipeline completion reliability from 90% to 98.5%.  
â€¢ Governed  data  quality  across  35+  financial  data  tables  using  Python,  pandas,  SQL  reconciliation,  schema 
validation, and business-rule checks, preventing 94% of data exceptions from reaching downstream reports.  
â€¢ Accelerated  Spark  and  PySpark  transformation  workflows  for  high-volume  transaction  datasets,  reducing 
batch processing time by 38% while maintaining standardized schemas across analytics layers.  
â€¢ Partnered  with  finance  analysts,  BI  developers,  data  engineers,  and  business  stakeholders  to  define  25+ 
reporting metrics and reconciliation rules, reducing recurring data discrepancies by 28%. 
 
PROJECTS 
SEC Financial Analytics Platform 
â€¢ Built  a  Python  data  pipeline  to  ingest,  parse,  and  standardize  10-K  and  10-Q  XBRL  filings  from  SEC  EDGAR, 
extracting revenue, net income, assets, liabilities, EPS, and cash flow into PostgreSQL.  
â€¢ Developed  9  dbt  models  for  revenue  growth,  operating  margin,  ROE,  debt-to-equity,  and  free  cash  flow, 
integrating historical equity-price data for comparative analysis across companies and fiscal periods.  
â€¢ Built  FastAPI  endpoints  and  an  interactive  financial  research  interface  for  company  screening,  peer 
comparisons,  multi-year  trend  analysis,  and  backtesting  rule-based  investment  strategies  against  market 
benchmarks.  
 
FinGPT: LLM-Driven Market News Research Tool 
â€¢ Built  FinGPT using  OpenAI  GPT-4  and  Perplexity  Sonar  API  to  synthesize  financial  news  and  research,  with 
Google Cloud Vision OCR for document text extraction and Streamlit as the interactive research interface.  
â€¢ Implemented RAG with LangChain, FAISS, and Sentence-BERT embeddings across 1,000+ indexed text chunks, 
grounding GPT-4 responses in retrieved financial context and reducing manual source review.  
â€¢ Parallelized multi-source ingestion with Python ThreadPoolExecutor, reducing end-to-end research latency by 
40% through concurrent web-research API calls and OCR processing for uploaded financial documents. 
 
EDUCATION 
Master of Science in Computer Science                      Aug 2023 - May 2025 
University of Southern Mississippi | Hattiesburg, MS 
 
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science           Aug 2019 - Apr 2023 
Acharya Nagarjuna University | India 
 
CERTIFICATIONS 
â€¢ AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate  
â€¢ Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate

ENUKAPALLY HEMANTH KUMAR 
Dublin, Ireland | +353 89 434 1731 | hemanth.enukapallu@applywizard.ai | LinkedIn | Portfolio 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Data Analyst with 3 years of professional experience supporting healthcare, banking, and operations analytics through data 
analysis,  reporting,  and  business  intelligence.  Skilled  in  SQL,  Python,  Excel,  Power  BI,  Tableau,  Databricks,  and  data 
visualization, with experience transforming operational data into dashboards, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and actionable 
insights.  Brings  hands-on  exposure  to  data  cleaning,  validation,  reconciliation,  ETL,  statistical  analysis,  and  business 
requirements, working across technical and functional teams to improve reporting accuracy and decision support. Combines 
Data Analyst and Business Analyst capabilities across healthcare and financial environments, with measurable experience 
supporting 15K+ records, operational KPIs, transaction analysis, and data-driven process improvement. 
 
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
Data  Analytics  &  Programming: SQL,  Python,  Pandas,  NumPy,  Exploratory  Data  Analysis  (EDA),  Data  Cleaning,  Data 
Transformation, Data Validation, Statistical Analysis 
Business Intelligence & Visualization: Power BI, Tableau, Advanced Excel, Power Query, DAX, Data Visualization, Interactive 
Dashboards, KPI Development, Executive Reporting 
Data Management & Engineering: Databricks, Delta Lake, ETL/ELT, Data Integration, Data Modeling, Relational Databases, 
Data Warehousing, Data Quality, Data Reconciliation 
Business  Analysis: Requirements  Gathering,  Business  Requirements  Documentation  (BRD),  Functional  Requirements,  Gap

Reporting  &  Decision  Analytics: Operational  Reporting,  Ad  Hoc  Analysis,  Trend  Analysis,  Variance  Analysis,  Performance 
Analysis, Product Analytics, Operational Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting Automation 
Product & Operations Analysis: KPI Analysis, Process Improvement, Workflow Analysis, Business Process Analysis, Data-Driven 
Decision Support, Stakeholder Analysis, Cross-Functional Requirements 
Tools & Delivery: Jira, Confluence, Git, Microsoft PowerPoint, Agile/Scrum, SDLC, Stakeholder Management, Cross-Functional 
Collaboration 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Data Analyst                            May 2022 - Jun 2024 
CGI | India 
â€¢ Analyzed healthcare and patient datasets using SQL and Python, profiling 15K+ records to identify data-quality issues 
affecting clinical and operational reporting.  
â€¢ Developed Power BI dashboards with Power Query and DAX to track 14+ operational KPIs, giving healthcare teams 
clearer visibility into patient activity, service trends, and performance.  
â€¢ Optimized complex SQL queries and relational data models across 6 reporting datasets, reducing recurring data-
preparation time by 22% for downstream analysis.  
â€¢ Automated data cleaning and transformation workflows using Python and Pandas, eliminating approximately 8 hours 
of manual preparation per month from recurring reporting cycles.  
â€¢ Reconciled  patient  and  operational  records  through  data  validation  and  quality  checks,  resolving  35+  data 
exceptions before information reached stakeholder reports.  
â€¢ Transformed  raw  healthcare  datasets  in  Databricks  through  structured  ETL  workflows,  standardizing  5+  source 
datasets for consistent analytical and reporting use.  
â€¢ Investigated  utilization  and  performance  patterns through  EDA  and  trend  analysis,  isolating  9 recurring  anomalies 
and helping operations teams focus corrective actions on underlying issues.  
â€¢ Translated  stakeholder  requirements  into  12+  KPI  definitions  and  reporting  specifications,  aligning  dashboard 
measures with healthcare operations and management reporting needs.  
 
Operations Analyst                        Jun 2021 - Mar 2022 
Axis Bank | India 
â€¢ Audited loan,  premium-payment,  and  customer transaction  data  using Advanced  Excel,  reviewing 600+  monthly 
records to identify mismatches before operational reporting.  
â€¢ Created Tableau dashboards to visualize 10+ banking KPIs across customer activity, transaction status, and service 
performance, simplifying recurring branch-level analysis.  
â€¢ Evaluated transaction  and account trends using SQL and Excel PivotTables,  examining 4+ reporting categories to 
surface payment exceptions and recurring operational patterns.  
â€¢ Streamlined  monthly  reporting  with  Excel  Power  Query,  lookup  functions,  and  PivotTables,  reducing  manual 
preparation effort by 18% across recurring reporting cycles.  
â€¢ Validated  customer,  loan,  and  payment  records  through  data  reconciliation  and  quality  checks,  identifying  25+ 
exceptions requiring correction before downstream review.  
â€¢ Mapped loan-management workflows through business process analysis, documenting 8 process gaps and reporting 
requirements during implementation of the new loan-management system.  

 
 
â€¢ Diagnosed account-access and transaction issues using root cause and variance analysis, categorizing 30+ service 
cases to reveal recurring operational failure patterns.  
â€¢ Monitored ATM, POS, and teller-system performance through operational reporting and KPI analysis, helping maintain 
99% operational uptime across customer-facing banking services.  
 
PROJECTS 
Patient Service Utilization Analysis 
â€¢ Examined  patient  service  records  across  24  months  using  Python  and  Pandas,  measuring  visit  frequency  and 
utilization patterns to identify periods of unusually high service demand.  
â€¢ Categorized utilization patterns across 7 service groups through descriptive statistics and cohort analysis, revealing 
differences in patient volumes for operational planning.  
â€¢ Synthesized  findings  into  a  management-ready  analytical  report  covering  13  performance  indicators,  helping 
healthcare stakeholders interpret demand patterns and resource utilization.  
 
Loan Portfolio & Payment Behavior Analysis 
â€¢ Profiled  loan  and  payment  behavior  across  1,500+  account  records  with  SQL,  grouping  customers  by  repayment 
activity and account characteristics for portfolio-level analysis.  
â€¢ Constructed a Tableau analytical view covering 9 portfolio measures, allowing business users to compare payment 
behavior, account composition, and loan-performance patterns.  
â€¢ Isolated  6  payment-behavior  patterns  through  customer  segmentation  and  comparative  analysis,  providing 
relationship teams with clearer indicators for account follow-up and portfolio review.  
 
Inventory Demand & Stock Optimization 
â€¢ Integrated  sales  and  inventory  information  for  150+  SKUs  using  Excel  and  Power  Query,  establishing  a  structured 
dataset for analyzing product movement and replenishment demand.  
â€¢ Projected short-term stock requirements from 12 weeks of historical movement,  identifying products with recurring 
demand fluctuations before scheduled replenishment cycles.  
â€¢ Ranked inventory across 4 movement bands using turnover and variance measures, highlighting the product groups 
requiring closer replenishment attention and reducing unnecessary manual review. 
 
EDUCATION 
Master of Science in Cloud Computing                 Sep 2024 - Oct 2025 
Dublin Business School | Dublin, Ireland 
 
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science                            Mar 2018 - Apr 2021  
Vasundhara Degree College | India 
 
CERTIFICATIONS 
â€¢ Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Professional Certificate - Coursera  
â€¢ Tableau Business Intelligence Analyst Professional Certificate - Coursera  
â€¢ IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate - Coursera  
â€¢ IBM Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst Professional Certificate - Coursera  
â€¢ IBM Business Analyst Professional Certificate - Coursera  
â€¢ Data Analysis and Visualization with Power BI - Coursera

Desktop, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets.

Boca Raton, FL  |+1 (561)696-8329 | ssunaitechjobs@gmail.com | LinkedIn | Portfolio 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
AI/ML  Engineer with 3+ years  of experience  building production-ready machine  learning and generative  AI systems 
across fintech and enterprise domains. Skilled in LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, and vector search using LangChain, 
OpenAI APIs, and Pinecone. Experienced in developing scalable ML pipelines on AWS SageMaker and Databricks with

in improving recommendation accuracy, reducing fraud false positives, and delivering reliable real-time AI systems. 
 
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
Artificial  Intelligence  &  Machine  Learning: Machine  Learning,  Deep  Learning  (CNN,  RNN,  LSTM),  Transformers  (BERT, 
GPT), LLM Fine-Tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Engineering, Embeddings, Semantic Search,

â€¢ Implemented  data  validation  frameworks  using  Great  Expectations  across  data  pipelines,  reducing  data 
inconsistencies and improving reliability of training datasets for downstream ML models. 
 
PROJECTS

â€¢ Built a RAG-based knowledge assistant using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, and Pinecone to query 10K+ internal

â€¢ Implemented document ingestion pipelines with chunking, metadata tagging, and vector indexing, enabling

â€¢ Developed an inference pipeline to convert extracted expressions into structured outputs, enabling real-time

Data Analyst | Business Intelligence | Reporting Analytics 
Whippany, NJ | +1 (201) 492-7039 | hanush.jagupilla@applywizard.ai | LinkedIn | Portfolio 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY  
â€¢ Data  Analyst  and Business  Intelligence professional with  4+  years  of experience building  dashboards,  reporting  datasets, 
and KPI views across insurance, manufacturing, and e-commerce environments. 
â€¢ Experienced in partnering with business, finance, operations, product, and leadership teams to translate reporting needs 
into clear insights that support faster decision-making. 
â€¢ Skilled at analyzing claims, policy, customer, inventory, sales, campaign, and operational data to identify trends, explain 
performance changes, and strengthen recurring business reporting. 
â€¢ Well-aligned  for Data  Analyst,  BI  Analyst,  Reporting  Analyst,  Operations  Analyst,  Product  Analyst,  and  Power  BI/Tableau-
focused analytics roles. 
 
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
Data Analysis & Reporting: Data Analysis, Business Intelligence Reporting, KPI Reporting, Operational Reporting, Executive Reporting, 
SQL  Reporting,  Report  Automation,  Ad  Hoc  Reporting,  Product  Analytics,  Customer  Analytics,  Financial  Analysis,  Trend  Analysis, 
Variance Analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Data Storytelling

Publishing, Data Visualization, Interactive Dashboards, Executive Dashboards, KPI Scorecards, Self-Service BI

Macros, Data Extraction

ETL

Source-to-Report Validation

Scrum 
AI-Assisted Analytics  &  BI: Power BI  Copilot, Tableau  Pulse,  Generative AI  for  Analytics, Prompt  Engineering  for Business  Reporting, 
Natural Language Querying, AI-Assisted Data Insights, Automated Insight Summarization, AI-Assisted Dashboard Narratives 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Data Analyst                                                                                                                                                         Jul 2025 - Present 
MetLife | Whippany, NJ  
â€¢ Built  and  published  8  Power  BI  dashboards  for  claims,  policy  renewals,  premium  movement,  and  retention  trends, 
strengthening executive reporting and giving insurance leaders a clearer view of service and revenue performance. 
â€¢ Prepared  Snowflake  ETL  reporting  datasets  and  SQL  data  extraction  logic  for  500K+  monthly  policy,  claims,  billing,  and 
customer records, creating cleaner inputs for BI reports and executive reviews. 
â€¢ Automated  weekly  KPI  reporting  and  SQL  reporting  outputs  through  Power  BI  Service,  Power  Query,  and  Excel  checks, 
improving report automation and cutting manual preparation by 35% for finance and operations users. 
â€¢ Tightened dashboard release quality through JIRA tracking, Confluence notes, UAT feedback, and validation rules, lowering 
reporting rework by 22% during production updates. 
â€¢ Analyzed policyholder behavior, claims history, billing activity, and renewal patterns with SQL, Python, Pandas, and Excel to 
surface retention risks and reporting gaps for business teams. 
â€¢ Created DAX measures and reporting models for claim cycle time, renewal conversion, premium trends, and service delays, 
improving executive reporting and data storytelling during business reviews. 
â€¢ Partnered  with  product  owners,  claims  teams,  finance  analysts,  and  operations  managers  to  define  KPI  logic  and  turn 
insurance questions into self-service BI dashboard views. 
â€¢ Used Power BI Copilot with structured prompts and natural language questions to summarize KPI movement, helping claims, 
premium, and retention teams review dashboard insights with clearer business context. 
 
Business Data Analyst                                                                                                                                    Aug 2021 - Aug 2023  
Accenture | India  
â€¢ Built SQL reporting models for production, inventory, cost, and plant operations data, giving a U.S.-based manufacturing 
client cleaner inputs for cost and performance reviews. 
â€¢ Created Tableau dashboards across 6 manufacturing workstreams, helping finance, supply chain, and operations leaders 
review production costs, inventory flow, and margin movement in one view. 
â€¢ Shortened  monthly  close-report  turnaround  by  30%  by  automating  recurring  cost  and  inventory  reports  with  SQL, Excel 
Macros, VBA, and validation checks for finance teams. 
â€¢ Reviewed  250K+  production,  inventory,  and  cost  records  to  uncover  material  usage  changes,  stock  movement  gaps, 
margin pressure, and planning risks before leadership discussions. 
â€¢ Raised recurring report accuracy by 24% by profiling source data, reconciling cost files, checking duplicates, and validating 
production and inventory reports before release. 
â€¢ Converted  operations  and  finance  requirements  into  Tableau  dashboards  and  Excel  reports,  helping  business  users 
compare plant performance, cost variance, and inventory trends with clearer KPI logic. 
â€¢ Examined cost variance, production volume, inventory levels, and historical trends using SQL and Excel, giving stakeholders 
stronger inputs for forecasting and monthly planning decisions. 
â€¢ Coordinated  JIRA  updates,  Confluence  notes,  Scrum  review  inputs,  and  UAT  feedback  for  dashboard  changes,  helping 
users confirm report accuracy before executive review cycles. 

Junior Business Analyst                                                                                                                                    May 2020 - Jul 2021  
Hexaware Technologies | India 
â€¢ Analyzed 420K+ sales, return, refund, and product records in SQL and Excel, helping a U.S. e-commerce client understand 
revenue shifts, return patterns, and category performance. 
â€¢ Designed Tableau  visuals  for  sales,  refunds,  campaign  results,  and  margin  trends,  raising  reporting  visibility by  25% during 
peak promotion and business review periods. 
â€¢ Streamlined campaign review work by preparing SQL extracts, Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP checks, and ROI calculations, cutting 
manual analysis effort by 20% for marketing and business teams. 
â€¢ Compiled weekly and ad hoc reporting packs across 15+ product categories, giving category managers clearer views of 
sales, discounts, returns, and margin behavior before pricing decisions. 
â€¢ Reconciled  sales,  vendor,  refund,  and  campaign  files  through  SQL  checks  and  Excel  validation,  giving  leadership  more 
dependable inputs for recurring performance reports. 
â€¢ Gathered reporting needs from marketing, finance, product, and operations teams, turning business questions into Tableau 
views and Excel KPI summaries for sales and profitability reviews. 
â€¢ Investigated  refund  spikes,  weak  category  performance,  and  campaign  variance  using  SQL  analysis  and  Excel  trends, 
helping teams understand where revenue leakage was occurring. 
â€¢ Documented dashboard test results, KPI logic, JIRA updates, and Confluence notes, helping business users confirm report 
accuracy before weekly leadership reporting cycles. 
 
PROJECTS 
Insurance Claims and Customer Retention BI Dashboard  
â€¢ Structured Snowflake and SQL datasets into a Power BI reporting model focused on claim aging, customer segments, and 
renewal behavior, giving users a cleaner view of retention drivers. 
â€¢ Built DAX measures and Power Query steps for claim aging, lapse rate, renewal conversion, and customer cohorts, cutting 
spreadsheet dependency by 40% during KPI review preparation. 
â€¢ Applied Python, Pandas, and NumPy to study policy lapse patterns and claim-frequency behavior, turning the findings into 
drill-down visuals for retention and operations analysis. 
 
Operations Reporting Automation Platform  
â€¢ Designed MS SQL Server queries for workload trends, exception aging, performance KPIs, and recurring operations reports, 
creating a reusable data layer for weekly management packs. 
â€¢ Automated Excel and Power Query refresh steps with VBA controls, decreasing report preparation time by 55% while keeping 
manual review checks available for business users. 
â€¢ Added SQL validation checks, duplicate reviews, and missing-value flags before Power BI publishing, strengthening report 
reliability for exception tracking and leadership reporting. 
 
Product and Category Performance Analytics Dashboard  
â€¢ Prepared PostgreSQL datasets with SQL to study category margin movement, discount behavior, and return concentration, 
giving users a cleaner base for product performance analysis. 
â€¢ Designed Tableau views and Tableau Pulse summaries for revenue movement, return behavior, campaign ROI, and margin 
shifts, increasing visibility across 12 product categories. 
â€¢ Used Excel analysis to flag underperforming categories, high-return products, and pricing gaps, turning category-level data 
into practical recommendations for sales and marketing teams.

Master of Science in Business Intelligence and Analytics                                                                                            May 2025 
Stevens Institute of Technology | Hoboken, NJ 
 
Bachelor of Business Administration                                                                                                                                May 2021  
Gayatri Vidya Parishad | India 
 
CERTIFICATIONS 
â€¢ Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate - Coursera 
â€¢ Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Professional Certificate - Coursera 
â€¢ IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate - Coursera 
â€¢ SQL Essential Training - LinkedIn Learning 
â€¢ Tableau Essential Training - LinkedIn Learning 
â€¢ Generative AI for Business Analysts - LinkedIn Learning

Business Intelligence Analyst Jul 2025 â€“ Present 
United Bank | Remote, USA 
â€¢ Defined deposit activity, lending trends, branch performance, and product KPI requirements with banking operations, finance,

â€¢ Reconciled 10K+ transactions across account activity, loan measures, branch totals, and customer segments with SQL, T-SQL,

â€¢ Examined customer journey patterns, product adoption, revenue movement, and branch service trends through SQL, Power BI,

stakeholders, keeping BI changes aligned with banking priorities during sprint delivery. 
â€¢ Presented executive dashboards, SLA reporting, KPI narratives, and business review findings to banking leaders, bringing monthly 
reporting accuracy to 98% through clearer validation and review cycles. 
  
Healthcare Data Analyst Dec 2024 â€“ May 2025 
Hartford Healthcare | Hartford, CT 
â€¢ Outlined  patient  access,  appointment  utilization,  referral  flow,  and  revenue-cycle  reporting  needs  through  stakeholder

â€¢ Delivered  KPI  reporting  summaries  and  data  storytelling  views  for  patient  access  and  operational  throughput,  helping 
healthcare leaders make better staffing, scheduling, and service-line decisions. 
  

 
Business Analyst Jul 2020 â€“ Jul 2023 
Wipro | Hyderabad, India

BRDs, FRDs, functional specifications, and process mapping, creating a clear delivery scope for reporting work..

datasets for trend analysis, variance analysis, and recurring KPI reporting. 
â€¢ Tested  calculated  measures,  report  outputs,  source  records,  and  dashboard  totals  with  SQL,  T-SQL,  Advanced  Excel, 
reconciliation checks, and UAT test scripts, reaching 97% first-pass reporting accuracy. 
â€¢ Maintained  data  dictionaries,  business  rules  documentation,  source-to-target  mapping,  workflow  diagrams,  and  role-based 
access notes in Confluence and Microsoft Visio, giving teams a shared reference for report changes. 
â€¢ Coordinated  defect  triage,  release  validation,  UAT  coordination,  and  business  sign-off  across  client  operations,  QA,  and 
reporting teams, cutting reporting defect rework by 24%. 
â€¢ Prepared  executive  dashboard  narratives,  SLA  reporting,  trend  analysis,  and  variance  analysis  in  Power  BI,  turning  reporting 
outputs into clearer service and process decisions for U.S. stakeholders. 
  
PROJECTS 
Predictive Analytics For Debt Recovery Optimization 
â€¢ Segmented  3,570  debt-recovery  accounts  with  SQL,  Advanced Excel,  customer  segmentation,  and  data  cleaning to group

â€¢ Built recovery KPI reporting in Power BI Desktop using Power Query, DAX, slicers, and drill-through reports, giving stakeholders a 
clear view of payment trends and collection focus areas. 
â€¢ Presented account-level insights through KPI scorecards, trend analysis, variance analysis, and data storytelling, helping prioritize 
outreach strategies based on recovery likelihood and payment patterns. 
  
E-Commerce Database Design And Implementation 
â€¢ Designed a relational database for customers, products, orders, payments, and order-line activity using SQL Server concepts,

â€¢ Created SQL views, CTEs, aggregate queries, and stored-procedure logic to evaluate order value, sales movement, customer

â€¢ Documented data dictionaries, report requirements, source-to-target mapping, and workflow diagrams to make the database 
structure easier to validate, explain, and extend for business reporting. 
  
Sales Analytics Dashboard Using Power Bi

â€¢ Calculated Total Sales, Sales Growth, Average Order Value, and product-level performance with DAX measures, dimensional

â€¢ Delivered an interactive Power BI dashboard with KPI scorecards, drill-through reports, slicers, trend analysis, and data storytelling 
to guide sales planning and underperforming-region review.

ADITYA POLA 
Charlotte, NC (Open to Relocate) | +1(704) 649-1917 | adity.apola@gmail.com | Portfolio 
  
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Data  Scientist  with  2+  years  of  experience  turning  complex  business  and  operational  data  into  predictive  models, 
analytical datasets, dashboards, and AI-enabled applications. Worked across pharmaceutical and financial-services 
environments, supporting data preparation, feature engineering, statistical analysis, model evaluation, reporting, and 
stakeholder decision-making. Brings hands-on exposure to machine learning, experimentation, NLP, retrieval-based AI, 
and  model  deployment  through  practical  work  and  applied  projects.  Skilled  at  connecting  technical  analysis  with 
business context,  helping teams  understand  patterns, improve  reporting  reliability, and  use  data-driven insights with 
confidence. 
  
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
Programming  &  Data  Analysis: Python,  SQL,  Pandas,  NumPy,  Jupyter  Notebook,  Exploratory  Data  Analysis,  Data 
Wrangling, Data Visualization 
Statistics  &  Experimentation: Statistical  Modeling,  Hypothesis  Testing,  A/B  Testing,  Confidence  Intervals,  Bootstrap 
Resampling, Cohort Analysis, Retention Analysis, Funnel Analysis, Segmentation 
Machine Learning: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Classification, Regression, Predictive Modeling, Feature Engineering, Feature 
Selection, Cross-Validation, Hyperparameter Tuning, Model Evaluation, Error Analysis, Class-Imbalance Handling 
Deep Learning & NLP: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Wav2Vec2, Natural Language Processing, Text 
Classification, Embeddings, Transfer Learning, Fine-Tuning 
Generative  AI  &  Retrieval: Retrieval-Augmented  Generation,  LangChain,  LangGraph,  MCP,  ChromaDB,  Semantic 
Search, Vector Search, Document Intelligence, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval Evaluation 
Data  Engineering  &  Databases: ETL/ELT,  Data  Pipelines,  Data  Preprocessing,  Data  Cleaning,  Data  Validation,  Data 
Quality Checks, Data Modeling, Apache Airflow, Databricks, Microsoft Azure 
Model Deployment & MLOps: MLflow, FastAPI, REST APIs, Docker, Streamlit, Experiment Tracking, API Deployment, Git 
Business Intelligence & Visualization: Power BI, DAX, Power Query, Tableau, Excel, Matplotlib, Dashboard Development, 
KPI Reporting 
  
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Data Scientist May 2023 - Jul 2024 
Cipla Ltd.  
â€¢ Analyzed pharmaceutical operations, product, and workflow datasets with Python, SQL, Pandas, and NumPy, 
turning source-level patterns into clearer model-ready business context. 
â€¢ Curated  machine  learning-ready  datasets  in  Databricks  by  cleaning  missing  values,  standardizing  formats, 
encoding  fields,  and engineering  features, creating cleaner  inputs  for  downstream  exploratory analysis  and 
predictive modeling. 
â€¢ Trained  classification  and  regression  models  with  Scikit-learn,  XGBoost,  cross-validation,  and  error  analysis, 
raising validation F1 score by 18% while helping teams interpret scoring outputs with stronger feature logic. 
â€¢ Validated  Azure  and  Databricks  pipelines  through  SQL  checks,  duplicate  detection,  range  validation,  and 
reconciliation logic, strengthening reliability across analytics datasets and model inputs. 
â€¢ Automated recurring preparation workflows in Apache Airflow with dependency checks, retry handling, and 
execution monitoring, cutting manual refresh effort by 28% across analytics cycles. 
â€¢ Profiled  100,000+  pharmaceutical  records  using Python, Pandas,  and  NumPy  to  normalize source  data,  flag 
anomalies, and prepare cleaner inputs for exploratory analysis and predictive modeling. 
â€¢ Partnered  with  data engineering,  reporting,  and business  teams  to  translate pharma workflow  requirements 
into structured datasets, model checks, and analytical summaries for stakeholder review. 
â€¢ Documented  feature  logic,  validation  rules,  model  assumptions,  and  dataset  definitions  in  Git-supported 
workflows, supporting 4 recurring analysis workflows and smoother cross-team handoffs. 
  
Data Analyst Jan 2022 - Apr 2023 
Western Alliance Bank  
â€¢ Consolidated customer, account, transaction, revenue, and operations data using SQL, Python, Pandas, and 
ETL/ELT workflows, cutting manual reporting preparation by 35%. 
â€¢ Built  8  Power  BI  dashboards  with  DAX,  Power  Query,  drill-down  views,  and  KPI  reporting,  giving  product, 
finance, and operations teams clearer visibility into banking performance. 
â€¢ Translated  stakeholder  reporting  needs  into  SQL  datasets,  KPI  definitions,  dashboard  logic,  and  recurring 
summaries, helping business teams make decisions from consistent performance data. 
â€¢ Standardized revenue, retention, funnel, and account-activity calculations across Power BI and Excel reports, 
creating cleaner reporting views for cross-functional business reviews. 
â€¢ Examined customer and transaction behavior through cohort analysis, retention analysis, funnel analysis, and 
segmentation, surfacing patterns that shaped engagement and service-planning recommendations. 

 
â€¢ Tuned  SQL joins,  aggregations, common  table  expressions, and  reporting  datasets  for  high-use  dashboards, 
boosting refresh performance by 25% across recurring analytics workloads. 
â€¢ Reconciled 50K+ transaction records with data profiling, outlier detection, completeness checks, and source-
to-report validation, strengthening accuracy before stakeholder-facing reports were shared. 
â€¢ Presented findings through Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and written analysis summaries, turning statistical trends 
into practical recommendations for retention, operations, and financial performance. 
  
PROJECTS 
Multimodal RAG System for Document Intelligence 
â€¢ Extended  a  multimodal  RAG  workflow  with  Python,  LangChain,  LangGraph,  MCP,  and  ChromaDB  to  route 
text, table, and figure-based evidence across 20 PDFs for document question answering. 
â€¢ Indexed   text  passages,   table  content,   and   image   and   figure-region  metadata   in   ChromaDB   using 
embeddings, semantic search, chunking, and metadata filtering, achieving 88% Top-5 retrieval on a labeled 
100-query benchmark. 
â€¢ Deployed  the  retrieval  workflow  through  FastAPI,  Streamlit,  Docker,  and  MLflow,  allowing  users  to  inspect 
retrieved text, tables, and figure-linked evidence while reviewing grounded responses. 
 
  
End-to-End MLOps Churn Prediction API 
â€¢ Created  a  churn  prediction  pipeline  with  Pandas,  Scikit-learn,  and  XGBoost for  feature  engineering,  cross-
validation, class-imbalance handling, and customer risk scoring. 
â€¢ Tuned model  performance  through  hyperparameter tuning,  model  evaluation, and  error analysis,  reaching 
0.88 ROC-AUC, 0.71 F1 score, and stronger results than a logistic baseline. 
â€¢ Published  the  selected  model  through  MLflow,  FastAPI,  and  Docker  with  validated  API  inputs,  supporting 
repeatable churn scoring for retention-focused decision planning. 
  
Speech Emotion Recognition Using Wav2Vec2 Transformers 
â€¢ Fine-tuned  a  Wav2Vec2  transformer  with  PyTorch  and  Hugging  Face  Transformers  to  classify  seven  speech 
emotion categories from uploaded audio samples. 
â€¢ Evaluated  predictions  with model  evaluation,  error  analysis, and class-level performance checks, achieving 
92% accuracy and identifying emotion classes with closer confusion patterns. 
â€¢ Delivered a Streamlit inference demo that processed audio inputs, displayed predicted emotion labels, and 
helped review model behavior across repeated test samples. 
  
Product Experimentation: Retention A/B Test 
â€¢ Designed  a  retention  experiment  analysis  with  Python,  Pandas,  and  NumPy  on  nearly  90K  player  records, 
defining Day-1 and Day-7 retention as decision KPIs. 
â€¢ Applied  hypothesis  testing,  confidence  intervals,  and  10,000+  bootstrap  resamples  to  measure  treatment 
effect, user-segment consistency, and retention movement. 
â€¢ Visualized cohort, funnel, and retention patterns with Matplotlib, translating statistical results into a clear ship-
or-no-ship recommendation for product planning. 
  
EDUCATION 
Master of Science in Computer Science May 2026 
University of North Carolina at Charlotte | Charlotte, NC 
  
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering (AIML) May 2024  
GITAM University | Hyderabad, India 
  
CERTIFICATIONS

â€¢ IBM Data Science Professional Certificate - Coursera 
â€¢ Machine Learning Specialization - Coursera 
â€¢ Deep Learning Specialization - Coursera 
â€¢ Generative AI with Large Language Models - Coursera
